objective: Using the eight immutable original SimpleMOS process TDRs, determine whether increasing the Workbench parameter named NWell (implemented by the process deck as background active boron) systematically creates shallow gate-edge donor-acceptor compensation, changes the NetActive zero-contour and mesh topology, and co-varies with the frozen M46 Id-Vg error amplification without changing any solved physics or production default.

semantic_guard.physical_interpretation: uniform p-type body/substrate background introduced by init field=Boron; it is not a masked conventional n-well implant
semantic_guard.sdevice_scope: n19 and n23 use the same SDevice physics and solve deck except for input/output names; process-generated TDR content is the intervention

closed_topics: M48-M50 fixed-state terminal and native substrate-face attribution
M55 contact-associated DopingWell topology and SRH attribution

allowed_operations: read and locally export the eight immutable original process TDRs with the existing sentaurus_import executable
read frozen M46 case and pointwise comparison artifacts
read accepted M55 and M57 reports as interpretation anchors
perform deterministic geometry, connectivity, contour, compensation, species, and correlation analysis
write analysis artifacts, evidence, tests, and documentation

frozen_analysis_rules.zero_contour: piecewise-linear NetActive=0 intersections in Silicon triangles, with edge crossings determined without state- or device-specific tolerance fitting
frozen_analysis_rules.contour_vertex_distance: minimum physical distance from each linearly interpolated contour-edge crossing to either endpoint of that mesh edge
frozen_analysis_rules.connectivity: same-sign Silicon nodes are connected by Silicon triangle edges; a component is contact-associated only when it intersects Silicon nodes belonging to that physical contact
frozen_analysis_rules.correlation: report Pearson and rank correlation as descriptive eight-device evidence only; no causal threshold is inferred from correlation magnitude

controls: all four matched low/high background-boron pairs
AsActive and PActive species decomposition rather than net-doping-only reconstruction

classifications.compensation_contour_mesh_sensitivity_su: All eight matched NWell/drain-voltage comparisons increase the M46 maximum Id error, every high-background-boron device has a stronger frozen shallow gate-edge compensation indicator than its matched low device, and at least one high device introduces an uncontacted or single-node same-sign component or a closer NetActive zero-contour-to-vertex approach.
classifications.compensation_strength_only: The M46 error trend and stronger high-background-boron shallow compensation are systematic, but the frozen connectivity and zero-contour proximity diagnostics do not change materially.
classifications.mesh_topology_without_systematic_compens: The error trend and mesh/connectivity changes are systematic, but shallow donor-acceptor compensation is not stronger in every high-background-boron device.
classifications.no_systematic_frozen_tdr_relation: The frozen M46 error amplification does not co-vary systematically with the predefined compensation, contour, connectivity, or mesh diagnostics.
classifications.upstream_or_field_identity_mismatch: An upstream hash, accepted status, required field, matrix size, active-species identity, or immutable TDR check fails.

analysis.claim_guard: M58 is a frozen-input structural attribution. A systematic relation supports a targeted local-remesh or compensated-mobility control, but does not prove that process diffusion, PhuMob, Sentaurus DopingWell construction, or Vela discretization is individually defective and does not authorize a production-model change.

forbidden_work: HFS, SG, quasi-Fermi, BGN, SRH, mobility-parameter, interface, contact-current, electrode, bias-path, or production-default change
process rerun, local remesh, dopant perturbation, contour repair, or floating-well merging in M58
choosing region limits, compensation thresholds, contour tolerances, classifications, or correlation gates after inspecting the complete matrix result
claiming causality or a solver defect from descriptive correlation alone
required_artifacts: frozen contract and immutable TDR/upstream hash manifest
four-pair species and common-coordinate comparison ledger
machine-readable report, evidence manifest, regression test, and human-readable report
